svg.title: run_dv.py architecture
svg.desc: The DV runner bootstraps its environment, resolves configuration, expands a run plan, executes build and test stages through the selected executor, parses evidence, and writes durable results.
svg.text: Configuration is resolved before backend work; scripts communicate with later reporting through files.
Executors: local runs leaves in-process; lsf and slurm submit target builds and attempts as scheduler jobs, first attempts in job arrays (run_dv.py --worker-manifest)
Result consumers: humans, CI, and run_dashboard.py
